_doc: Debts with names on them. Every hook bypass and every documented test exception is listed here with who authorised it, the observed refusal it covers, and what closes it. Nothing reads this file as a gate; it exists so that no exception is silent. An allowlist that can be extended by whoever trips it is not a gate: additions require Mahmood's authorisation and a reason.

Log: docs/evidence/enforcement-gate-2026-09-21/13-verify-all-observed-run3.log (runs 1 and 2, on trees that no longer exist, are kept in 14 for signal only)
hook_bypasses.scope: Suspends only the pre-commit hook's verify_all on THIS commit. Observed on staged tree 3128458bf0432845ee9e13ea3706166cfe38da72; the commit adds only what records the observation (this entry, the run-3 log in the evidence dir, and their renders). The three refusals are the designed RED state of the enforcement gate: (1) unit tests -- exactly the two tests that assert a served page passes the WHOLE gate (tests/test_gate.py::test_real_review_reproduces_and_passes_full_gate; tests/test_result_withdrawn.py[dapagliflozin-hfpef-hosp]), 1,429 passed; (2) the publication gate on 24 of 32 pages -- 41 result-change notices OPEN for the reviewer's countersignature (check_result_change_countersigned) and 11 pages whose every candidate primary row was set aside on P5 (check_primary_result); (3) the honest-state ratchet, whose pre-commit base resolves to HEAD~1 = 8f14f411 while HEAD == origin/main and therefore spans TWO landings (M2's and this one) -- against 38c04411, the served state and CI's merge-base once this commit exists, the same limb passes with 0 refusals (observed). It does not suspend any check on main: main accepts only a SHA whose CI verify passed, and this SHA will not pass CI by design.
hook_bypasses.why: A gate that is red on the 53 rows today cannot be committed under a hook that requires green; the alternative (an opt-in gate, or dropping rows to reach green) is the defect the gate exists to prevent. The tree is pushed red so the reviewer can decide with the artefacts in front of him.
hook_bypasses.removal_condition: This entry is CLOSED when verify_all passes on the enforcement-gate branch tip -- which requires, per page: every OPEN notice countersigned by Mahmood (scripts/countersign_result_change.py) or its result restored by eligibility evidence; every primary pool emptied by P5 either re-populated by a bound family-eligibility record or given a typed state Mahmood rules on; and any screening acknowledgement the ratchet asks for signed by name. The closing commit's sha is to be written into `closed_by` here; until then the branch is not a candidate for main.
